snapshot.title: Handle merged branches
snapshot.description:
Two branches can each change the same item (both at revision N), or together form a dependency cycle no single change created.

- After a merge, record the merged result as a new revision (history.proto, ChangeEvent.revision).
- A pre-existing cycle must not block unrelated task moves: today UpdateItem runs `core.HasCycle` over all items and rejects any reparent while a cycle exists, with a message blaming the move. Reject only changes that create a new cycle (compare before and after), and report existing cycles so the user can fix them.
